figurative_meaning_en: To fool or deceive someone; to trouble or harass in various ways
similar_in_english: To take someone for a ride
To pull the wool over someone's eyes
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ীরা গ্রাহকদের মুরগী বানিয়ে লাভ করছে।
সে তার বন্ধুকে মুরগী বানিয়ে টাকা হাতিয়ে নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Businessmen are making chickens out of customers to earn profits.
He made a chicken out of his friend and pocketed the money.
note: This idiom draws from rural imagery of chickens being easily manipulated or plucked, common in Bengali folk expressions.
